result.summary: Fixed MAPREDUCE-7376: ValueAggregatorJob.setAggregatorDescriptors wrote the descriptor spec under key `mapreduce.aggregate.descriptor<i>` while ValueAggregatorJobBase.getAggregatorDescriptors reads `mapreduce.aggregate.descriptor.<i>`, so user plugins (e.g. AggregateWordCount.WordCountPlugInClass) were silently dropped and the job fell back to the default descriptor emitting record_count totals. Changed the write to `ValueAggregatorJobBase.DESCRIPTOR + "." + i` and added TestAggregateWordCount in hadoop-mapreduce-examples asserting `Hadoop\t1`, `Hello\t2`, `World\t1` for input "Hello World\nHello Hadoop".
result.notes: One-line production fix; the read side (`DESCRIPTOR + "." + i`) was left untouched so the existing TestMapReduceAggregates, which sets `ValueAggregatorJobBase.DESCRIPTOR + ".0"` directly, still passes, and the new-API key form now matches the old mapred API's `aggregator.descriptor.<i>`. The fix also repairs AggregateWordHistogram, which uses the same descriptor-registration path. Test runs on LocalJobRunner + local FS (no cluster) and uses MapReduceTestUtil.readOutput from the jobclient test-jar, already a test dependency of hadoop-mapreduce-examples. Not compiled (mvn forbidden); verified by inspection that every referenced symbol exists.
